owner_request: 2026-10-15, in chat: 'i dont want it to just be a strategy that trading on the peers, i want the main wave'
why_this_exists: The main wave's first visible step is usually a leader's own results: NVDA's 2023-05-24 report (+24% the next day) started the repricing that took it from +95% to +760% (Step 359). This buys the leader itself, not its peers, the day after a blowout results day, and holds for months. Literature, recalled and not read this session: Brandt, Kishore, Santa-Clara & Venkatachalam (2008) find drift after large earnings-announcement returns; Martineau (2022) finds post-earnings drift has largely disappeared in large caps. Step 360's diagnostic found leaders jumping for ANY reason did not drift (126d: -0.36% design), so the question is whether RESULTS-driven jumps differ.

data.results_dates: SEC 8-K Item 2.02 acceptance datetimes from EDGAR submissions (the method of scripts/acquire_sec_earnings_8k_v1.py, extended back to 2012 for the names that are ever in the top 500 by liquidity); raw cached in data/sec_historical_identity_cache

events.universe: each day, the 500 most liquid stocks (63-day median dollar volume, close >= $5), as A24
events.reaction_day: the first trading day whose close comes after the 8-K acceptance time (acceptance after 16:00 New York time -> next trading day)
events.blowout: reaction-day return minus the equal-weight liquid-universe return >= +10%

entry_and_outcome: buy at the close of reaction day + 1; return over h trading days minus the mean of 50 random liquid same-SIC2 firms (A24's control)
significance: event-level outcomes, block bootstrap over event months (block 3), 4000 draws, two-sided
pass_rule_per_trial: design mean > 0 with p < 0.025 AND holdout mean > 0 AND design mean survives dropping its 10 largest events AND design mean > 50 bps
diagnostics_not_verdicts: non-results jumps of the same size (A24's leaders minus results days)
the 20 largest events listed by name
book_only_if_a_trial_passes: long-only, equal weight across live events, each held h days, costs 0/10/50/100 bps, vs SPY and the equal-weight universe; CAGR, Sharpe, max drawdown, beta, per regime, leave-top-5-names-out
cumulative_search_note: Two new trials on top of 363 steps.
known_weaknesses_declared_up_front: 8-K Item 2.02 also covers preliminary results and some non-earnings disclosures; a few reaction days will be mislabelled.
Survivorship in the price panel as A19.
Large-cap leaders only: the drift literature finds effects concentrated in smaller, less-followed firms.
